item.title: Wardogs Season 3 Will Add A Mode That Limits What Weapons Players Can Use
item.description: Bulkhead and Team17 shared the first details on what players can expect from Wardogs Season 3 in a new video. One of the most notable additions is Limited Mode, a new way to play Wardogs that restricts what weapons and other upgrades players have access to.

item.title: Path of Exile 2 Sets The Stage For Massive Update Alongside December Launch
item.description: At ExileCon 2026, Grinding Gear Games gave us a deep dive into everything we can expect to be added to Path of Exile 2 by the time its 1.0 launch happens next month. That includes a new stealth-driven class, two more narrative acts for its campaign, and a new league called Conquerors of Wraeclast .

item.title: GI Joe and Paranormal Activity Get New Official Release Dates from Paramount
item.description: Paramount Pictures has announced that Danny McBride's G.I. Joe reboot is expected to premiere in movie theaters in late 2028. Unfortunately, not all news is good; Paramount has also pushed back the next installment in the Paranormal Activity horror series by six months.

item.title: One Of Hollywood's Biggest Stars Just Auditioned For James Bond
item.description: As auditions for the next James Bond continue, new names are emerging and revealing which actors are up for the role. The latest on this from The Hollywood Reporter was particularly surprising, as it revealed some A-list Hollywood talent screen-tested for 007.

item.title: Ridley Scott’s R-Rated Sci-Fi Masterpiece is Officially Being Cut From Netflix
item.description: Ridley Scott has directed some of the most iconic science fiction movies of all time, from Blade Runner to The Martian . However, few have had the same lasting impact as his 1979 sci-fi horror classic Alien . The film helped redefine the genre by combining the terror of a slasher movie with the vast, isolating setting of outer space, introducing audiences to one of cinema's most memorable monsters in the process.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Cows
item.description: From 1980 until 1995, cartoonist Gary Larson wrote and drew The Far Side . It was a single panel comic strip filled with non-sequitur, surreal jokes mostly aimed at adults instead of children, which was unusual for newspaper comics at the time. Also unusual was the fact that, unlike most daily comic strips, The Far Side had no recurring characters. Peanuts has its gang of kids and Garfield has its cast of humans and animals, but every panel of The Far Side introduces new characters and scenarios all aimed at delivering one single joke.

item.title: Mass Effect’s Cruelest Moral Choice Remains Gaming's Most Haunting Mission 19 Years Later
item.description: So when, years later, an Alliance clerk told Shepard that a fallen marine named Nirali Bhatia “may save more lives in death than she did in life,” Shepard was faced with the decision — the opportunity — to make Nirali’s death count for something. Before the question ended, she was already agreeing. Hand a grieving husband his wife’s body? Or keep her for research that might save more lives down the line? Someone was going to pay for whichever answer I chose. (I knew Shepard would say yes. I also knew, thumbs hovering over the controller, that every part of me wished she wouldn’t.)

item.title: Sydney Sweeney's New Netflix Sci-Fi Epic Is Mandatory Viewing For Transformers Fans
item.description: Transformers is a franchise that has built-in appeal in more ways than one. Apart from the concept of giant robots transforming into vehicles, there's the fact that two factions of these robots have been engaged in a war that spans millenia. There have been highs (including the grossly underrated Transformers One ) and lows (including most of Michael Bay's films ), but it's more than likely that we'll be seeing Transformers stories until the heat death of the universe. Netflix is aiming to deliver its own take on another property that features giant robots, and it's tapped Sydney Sweeney to play a leading role in this potential franchise.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Star Trek Perfectly Captures the Sci-Fi Show’s Most Brutal Running Joke
item.description: Generating creature tokens is a common way to make the most out of your resources in a game of Magic: The Gathering . They can be sacrificed for powerful effects, used to chump block , or amassed to overwhelm your opponent. Cards typically generate tokens of the same color, like white Warriors for Secure the Wastes , green Squirrels for Deranged Hermit , and black Zombies for Ghoulish Procession . Yet numerous cards in Magic: The Gathering Star Trek generate 1/1 red Officer tokens regardless of the base color, from the white Captain Benjamin Sisko to the green MACO Strike Team . The discrepancy is a nod to the sci-fi franchise’s darkest running joke.
